name: effect-manager-benchmark
scope: Synthetic manager-only benchmark, frozen server, inert Effect callbacks in isolated fixture pack, armor stands, 1/5/10/20 Effects and 1/20 owners. One warmup and three profiled batches of 1000 owner-ticks per case. Batch is scheduled after a profiler activation tick. Exact completed batches and remaining durations are asserted. debug elapsed time includes profiling, background core ticks and RCON scheduling overhead; not gameplay MSPT. Compare same scenario on HEAD and working tree.
